newsitem.title: RUSSIA: GYMNASTICS-BONDARENKO AND KHORKINA DEFEND THEIR TITLES.
newsitem.headline: GYMNASTICS-BONDARENKO AND KHORKINA DEFEND THEIR TITLES.

text.p: Defending Russian champion Alexei Bondarenko stole the show with his solid performance as he won three gold medals on Sunday, the final day of the national gymnastic championships.
The 19-year-old Muscovite, who claimed the overall men's title on Saturday, swept the vault, the rings and the parallel bars golds.

In the absence of double Olympic gold medallist Alexei Nemov, who is still recovering from a shoulder injury, Bondarenko will lead a strong Russian men's team into the world championships, which open in Lausanne, Switzerland on August 31.
Svetlana Khorkina, the world and Olympic champion on the asymmetric bars, won her favourite apparatus on Sunday with a score of 9.800 to add another gold to her overall women's title.
